about: Expected POD.insights.build(F, allResults(F), now) for docs/insights-contract.md. F = the receipts' _base.json S with speed 27, merged with `patch` (objects merge key by key, except cart, creditOptIn, markup, credits, deal and menu, which replace whole). now = [year, month0, day] as a local date (new Date(y, m, d, 12)), or null for an invalid Date (new Date(NaN)). `expect` is the full output, compared exactly (id, label, cls, text, data). `hand` lists the values worked by hand in build.py; the generator asserts the reference agrees.
